summary: community.general breaking changes in Ansible 9: compatibility code for old Ansible removed from collection_version and selective, gitlab_project now applies default_branch on update, VarDict rejects some reserved variable names, and version-based plugins no longer support ansible-core 2.11.
questions: gitlab_project changed my default branch unexpectedly, why?
Why does VarDict reject a variable named as_dict?

answer_card.title: community.general 9.0 breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `gitlab_project`: **`default_branch`** is now applied when updating a project (previously ignored). Only pass it if you want that value.
- `collection_version` lookup and `selective` callback: compat code for Ansible 2.9 / ansible-base 2.10 / ansible-core 2.11 removed.
- `version` module util: **ansible-core 2.11 no longer works** with plugins that use it.
- `VarDict` rejects variables named `_var`, `get_meta`, `as_dict`.
